svg.text: Where does the control come from?

g.title: ablations isolate where control originates motion-control error lower better
g.desc: The ablations isolate where control originates.
g.text: Isolating the source of temporal control
Metric: motion-control error on 1,000 caption–video pairs — lower is better.

g.title: only text gives motion-control error four point zero three baseline
g.desc: Using only text gives a motion-control error of 4.03.

g.title: adding motion vectors temporal condition drops two point six seven enabling STC-encoder lowers two point one eight
g.desc: Adding motion vectors as a temporal condition drops it to 2.67, and enabling the Spatio-Temporal Condition encoder lowers it to 2.18.

g.title: both matter motion vectors supply signal STC-encoder makes model use it
g.desc: Both matter: motion vectors supply the signal, and the STC-encoder makes the model use it.
g.text: Both matter: motion vectors supply the temporal signal,
and the STC-encoder makes the model actually use it.
Without the STC-encoder, temporal structure and consistency degrade.
